name: stage1_start
title: Stage-I analytic design point (contraction screen + tap engagement)
description: NOT a tuned point: this is the starting point for the Stage-II search.
Gauge g_v is pinned so that the supervisory voltage priority pi = g*sigma^2 equals 1.
Continuous scale placed by bisection so lambda_max(B) = 1.0 on the worst
area and condition of each layer; tap weights priced from a stated
engagement deviation of 0.010 pu (TS) and 0.020 pu (STS).
All 42 area-condition values of lambda_max(B) lie at or below 1.0,
against a screen of 0.8*2 = 1.6 and a selection ceiling of 1.546.
shunt_int_g_w added 2026-09-11. It sits in the gauge-invariance group with
the nine weights, so it must travel with the parameter set; leaving it in
make_config at its old-gauge value of 10 made the eight shunt banks inert
for the entire campaign (accumulated state peaked at 0.395 Mvar against a
22.5 Mvar commit threshold, zero commits in 5 h with disturbances).
Value 0.03 derived from a 30 min persistence at the measured p90 boundary
pressure |g_H| = 0.133; the independent gauge-consistent rescale of the old
value gives 0.040, so the two routes agree within 30 %.
A single very large demand may still commit within one supervisory period:
the anti-windup clamp (25 Mvar) sits above the threshold (22.5), and that
behaviour was accepted as desirable rather than designed out.
